title: InferCept: Efficient Intercept Support for Augmented Large Language Model Inference
technique: Min-waste interception: dynamically chooses Preserve/Discard (chunked)/Swap per intercepted request by GPU memory-waste equations; chunked recompute and swap pipelined with forward passes

optimized_metrics.evidence: minimize GPU memory ... waste caused by interceptions so that the same amount of ... GPU resources can be used to serve more requests.
so that the same amount of ... GPU resources can be used to serve more requests.

headline_claim.text: InferCept improves the overall serving throughput by 1.6×-2× and completes 2× more requests per second compared to the state-of-the-art LLM inference systems.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we first report the serving throughput as normalized latency (i.e., the median of every request's end-to-end latency divided by its output length) when varying request load (number of requests arrived per second). We also remove a request's intercepted time from its end-to-end latency because it is the same across all serving systems.
metric_definitions.notes: Median (not mean) of E2E / output length, request level; tool/interception time subtracted. 'Sustained throughput' = request rate at which normalized latency stays low.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we also report the number of finished requests per second (i.e., throughput)
the time from request arrival to the first generated token (i.e., TTFT)
metric_definitions.notes: Includes queueing (arrival to first token); for intercepted workloads measured to first token of the request, not per resumption.

load_regime: request-rate sweep (req/s) on mixed augmentation workload (math, QA, VE, chatbot, image, TTS) with synthetic/real interception durations
tradeoff_acknowledged: TTFT can be worse than vanilla vLLM (vLLM TTFT better because it discards/queues interceptions); chunked resource sharing minimizes but does not remove overhead.
workloads: Six augmentation types (arithmetic, QA, virtual environment, chatbot, image generation, TTS) mixed workload
extractor_notes: Request-level metrics only (intercepted time removed), so program/agent completion time is NOT measured; 'throughput' ambiguity: abstract 'overall serving throughput' operationalised as sustainable request rate at given normalized latency plus finished req/s. Optimization target is GPU memory waste (a means to higher throughput).
load_class_quote: request arrival rate at the same normalized latency [§6 Fig 2: request-rate sweep on mixed augmentation workload]
